articles.summary: May is Skin Cancer Awareness Month and skin cancer is America’s most common form of the disease with more than five million cases diagnosed in the United States each year. Fortunately, it’s also one of the most preventable cancers. That’s why Avery Dennison® (NYSE:AVY) has partnered with The Skin Cancer Foundation to encourage people to check their skin for warning signs and reduce long-term exposure to the sun’s harmful rays.
